claims.quote: Our design prioritizes eﬀiciency within resource constraints while minimizing risk through proven architectural patterns.
claims.reason: The 102B/12B MoE and 20T-token budget are a release specification, not an ARCH novelty. MoE is attributed to Shazeer et al. 2017, and the authors say they follow proven patterns (gpt-oss/GLM-style top-8 of 128 plus one shared expert). The 10B-A1B vs 3B dense run is a confounded prototype study of other choices, not a matched ablation of this element, so it is not kept.

claims.quote: Second, we coordinate this data through a progressive curriculum jointly optimizing composition, quality thresholds, and domain coverage across 20 trillion tokens.
claims.reason: Authors present a data curriculum (composition, language-aware quality thresholds, domain coverage), which is DATA, not a TRAIN novelty (optimizer, LR schedule, stability, or objective). They do not claim a new training algorithm. The GLM-4.5-Base trajectory comparison is a different model/data/token budget, not a with-vs-without ablation of the curriculum, so ablation is NO and the claim is not kept.
